artists.source_line: Dance to the rhythms of salsa, bachata, and kizomba with your captain, Steve Bakoula! 🎵💃🕺
Dance through Greece on an unforgettable cruise with SBK Cruise, from May 2nd to 9th, 2026

features.rationale: The description states the event takes place aboard a cruise ship.

features.quote: Daily dance lessons (2 hours of lessons per day onboard)
features.rationale: Daily dance lessons are part of the cruise package.
The event offers themed evenings with a dress theme.
The price includes the onboard accommodation package.
Full board meals are included in the price.
A round-trip bus transfer is included in the price.
